entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No. 134/2023, registered at Police Station-Vishwavidyalaya, District Rewa (MP) for the offence under Section 420 of Indian Penal Code.
2. As per prosecution story, applicant had sold the same land twice.
First, land was sold to complainant and thereafter, again it was sold to some other person.
Applicant was having full knowledge of agreement and despite knowing all the facts, he again sold the land in question to third person.
Registered sale deed executed by applicant was not cancelled and was also enforced.
